proof_candidate_rejection_criteria.description: Criteria for rejecting a proof candidate from elevation to formalized or closed status.

criteria_list.name: hidden_boundary_case
criteria_list.description: Failure to document or classify boundary behavior (e.g., epsilon=0, window edges).

criteria_list.name: unresolved_dependency
criteria_list.description: Reference to an object with status lower than derivation_supported.

criteria_list.name: implicit_global_claim
criteria_list.description: Claim implies framework-wide closure without explicit local-only scoping.

criteria_list.name: theorem_promotion_without_authorization
criteria_list.description: Automatic status change without explicit manual directive.

criteria_list.name: formalization_without_machine_or_explicit_human_review
criteria_list.description: Status moved to formalized without a valid review artifact.

criteria_list.name: physics_claim_leakage
criteria_list.description: Assertion of physical truth or experimental validation in a mathematical proof.

criteria_list.name: failure_mode_suppression
criteria_list.description: Omission of known instability, divergence, or undefined states.
